description: Turn project ids into domains, along with the project's other domains (regional versions, mirrors) and, when known, the service through which the project entered the corpus: a payment service or platform on whose page its visitors complete payment. Costs the base price plus the reveal price for every project your organization has not already revealed, by this tool or by a lookup_domain hit; a newly revealed project also spends one unit of coverage if it was not seen this period. A reveal lasts for the whole organization as many days as capabilities reports in reveal_ttl_days: while it holds, every later response shows the domain automatically at no further charge, revealing the project again neither charges nor extends it, and after it lapses the project is anonymous again until revealed anew. Reveal only the projects your user needs named: descriptions, bands and niches are readable without it. For a domain your user already has, lookup_domain finds and reveals its project without the reveal price.
